ConnectorEnvelope/v1: request hash equals canonical request payload bytes
ConnectorErrorResponse/v1: ID, request contract, method and canonical request hash bind one phase; failure class matches the supervisor external-I/O phase
ConnectorInitializeRequest/v1: ID, connector binding, capability manifest, manifest, worker executable, CapabilityGrant, exact operation provider scopes, CredentialGrant and deadline bind exactly
ConnectorInitializeSuccess/v1: ID and every connector-binding, capability-manifest, grant and executable authority hash bind the selected request
ConnectorInvokeRequest/v1: phase-unique ID, verified connector binding, manifest operation effect class, exact provider scopes and both grants bind the exact ConnectorEnvelope
ConnectorInvokeSuccess/v1: ID and ConnectorResult.request_sha256 bind canonical ConnectorEnvelope bytes; result deadline, outcome kind and payload output schema match the selected manifest operation
ConnectorManifest/v1: operation IDs are unique and stdout carries all maximum frames; the short-worker handshake requires the exact sealed frame/count/stdout budgets
ConnectorProtocolFailure/v1: supervisor phase maps every fatal protocol violation to internal_failure before possible external I/O or ambiguous_transport after it, with no automatic resend
DelegatedWork/v1: deadline follows creation and task is at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes
DelegatedWorkGrant/v1: maximum_total_tokens is at least both the input and output token limit
DelegatedWorkResult/v1: output is at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes; output_sha256 binds its exact UTF-8 bytes; spec_sha256 equals the selected durable DelegatedWork/v1
DelegatedWorkUsage/v1: when token counters are present total_tokens equals input_tokens plus output_tokens
DeliveryOffer/v2: expiry follows offer time; installation, channel, request, conversation and ACK key equal the authenticated IngressRequest/v1
DeliveryReceipt/v1: selected DeliveryOffer hash, delivery/content/wire, proof mode and client ACK request/challenge/algorithm/key match exactly
DeliveryReceipt/v2: authenticated ingress, v2 offer, delivery, PresenceReply, wire, P-256 profile, signature, pre-bound key and transaction-bound one-time challenge claim match exactly; v1 is never a fallback
DocumentDraft/v1: content is at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes
EpisodeState/v1: generation supersedes exactly its arithmetic predecessor
EvaPortableArchive/v1: encrypted object count equals the sum of chunk counts
EvidenceEnvelope/v2: object reference pair is complete; tenant, aggregate, positive sequence and idempotency key are required
PlannerRequest/v1: context selection hash equals the complete embedded PresenceContext
PlatformLock/v1: target set equals the sealed platform matrix
PlatformLock/v2: target set equals the sealed platform matrix
PlatformLock/v3: target set equals the sealed platform matrix
PlatformLock/v4: first WSL2 amd64 target; selected profiles cannot claim support; validated target and immutable image evidence required
PresenceContext/v1: embedded IdentityPack hash and relationship/consent scope equal the enclosing context
ValidatedPlan/v1: step IDs are unique and dependencies form a topologically ordered DAG

CalendarDate: lexical components form a valid proleptic Gregorian date
Timestamp: UTC second-precision lexical components form a valid proleptic Gregorian date and clock time
